decision_rationale: This is a primary model paper, but the provided methods only support biological token sequences as “cell sentences” of gene names rather than a substantive natural-language text component. The model does use generative LLMs autoregressively, but the text-bio bridge is not clearly supported as a real text modality.
evidence_snippet: “Cells were represented using cell sentences … where gene names are listed in descending order of expression level” and “passed to text encoders … or to generative LLMs … through autoregressive generation”
